LOCAL-FIRST DESIGN

Security, Privacy & File Architecture

How DAW Buddy protects your files and guarantees zero third-party telemetry.

The Electron Security Airlock

DAW Buddy strictly isolates its Node.js backend from the browser UI. The window has zero file access; all read/write operations pass through explicit, validated ContextBridge endpoints in src/preload/.

Renderer (Sandboxed UI)
└── [Context Bridge Airlock]
    └── Main Process (Scoped File System Only)

Zero External Transmission

Your music, stems, sample paths, and notes never leave your computer. Notes and settings live in standard local app data (notes.json, settings.json, cache.json).

  • ✓ No Account Required: Install and run immediately.
  • ✓ No Analytics/Telemetry: Zero analytics beacons or telemetry pings.
  • ✓ Non-Destructive Operations: Audio tools always create new copies.
